main_failure_modes: The complete initial-anchor-to-SIGINT-discounting mechanism is labeled Confirmation bias rather than Anchoring Bias.
A separate high-confidence Anchoring bias finding captures only the initial corridor-based narrowing and misses the required later SIGINT update failure.
The Overconfidence bias finding is moderate confidence, so it is missed by the high-only threshold.
main_strengths: Every positive segment is detected at high_and_moderate confidence.
Authority, groupthink, framing, and overconfidence findings match their hidden mechanisms and labels (including approved label variants).
The output distinguishes the two Phase 3 mechanisms and uses transcript evidence that is verbatim.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run has complete segment-level coverage at the recommended threshold and complete mechanism-first instance recall, but strict performance is lower because of one taxonomy error and one incomplete duplicate anchoring account.
